name: dev-flow
description: AI agent first development process. A single `dev-flow` skill drives the five-phase flow (1. ADR -> 2. Requirements + Design + Spec -> 3. Test -> Implementation -> 4. Documentation -> 5. Done) by delegating each phase to a dedicated subagent (`dev-flow-<name>` under `~/.cursor/agents/`). At each phase boundary, the corresponding auditor subagent (`dev-flow-<phase>-auditor`) is auto-invoked via its description (no manual user invocation expected). The `dev-flow` skill itself uses `disable-model-invocation: true` since it is the explicit prompt entry point.
